summary: Backend layouts API fully validated (5 new tests + 61 existing = 66/66 pytest). CRITICAL frontend wiring bug found: /admin/layouts route is NOT registered in App.js so the new AdminLayouts page is unreachable and silently redirects to home. Dice page renderBlock + dice-feed testid present (verified via code & default layout API response).

ui_bugs.issue: Route /admin/layouts is NOT registered. AdminLayouts.jsx exists (and is fully implemented with save/reset/tabs/slots/cfg controls), but App.js only registers /admin and /admin/rules. Visiting /admin/layouts hits the catch-all `<Navigate to="/" replace />` and silently redirects to home — the DM cannot reach the layout editor from the UI at all.
No nav link to /admin/layouts. The Admin.jsx tile list only has rules-admin-link. DM has no in-app way to discover the new Page Layouts editor even once the route is added.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot be tested end-to-end through the UI because the route is missing. Backend PUT /api/layouts is verified working via pytest (see test_put_layouts_admin_persists_and_reflects which moves live_feed Side→Main and back), so the data layer is fine — only the frontend route registration is missing.

action_items: Add `<Route path="/admin/layouts" element={<ProtectedRoute requireAdmin><AdminLayouts /></ProtectedRoute>} />` to /app/frontend/src/App.js (and import AdminLayouts from './pages/AdminLayouts'). Place it next to the existing /admin/rules entry, BEFORE the catch-all `<Route path="*" element={<Navigate to="/" replace />}/>`.
Add a tile/link entry to /app/frontend/src/pages/Admin.jsx tiles list pointing to /admin/layouts (e.g. `{ to: "/admin/layouts", label: "Page Layouts", icon: Layout, testid: "layouts-admin-link" }`).
After wiring, re-run the AdminLayouts UI flow: move live_feed Side→Main, Save, navigate to /dice, confirm dice-feed renders in main column; then restore.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Once the main agent registers /admin/layouts in App.js, re-run a Playwright flow as DM: (1) goto /admin/layouts, (2) click [data-testid='tab-dice_page'], (3) select_option on [data-testid='slot-select-live_feed'] → 'left', (4) click [data-testid='save-layout-btn'], (5) goto /dice and assert [data-testid='dice-feed'] is now in the main column (single column on /dice — selector that worked: page.locator("[data-testid='dice-feed']").count() == 1). Note: /dice asks anon users for a 'name at the table' before rendering any blocks; login as DM first OR submit the name form to see live_feed. block-gear on character sheet is correctly conditional on equipment/features/languages being non-empty (wawa has none, so it does not render — that's expected, not a bug).
rca of the issue: AdminLayouts.jsx file was created and is fully functional (all data-testids, save/reset/move/config controls present), but /app/frontend/src/App.js was never updated to add the <Route path="/admin/layouts"> entry. Because App.js has `<Route path="*" element={<Navigate to="/" replace />} />` as a catch-all, the URL silently redirects to home instead of throwing a 404 — making the issue invisible without a manual visit. Fix: import AdminLayouts and add the protected route entry alongside /admin/rules; also add a discoverability tile on Admin.jsx.
